gwt.given: data is a 16-byte span of all-zero bytes with position already advanced to 1 (so only 15 bytes remain ahead of the cursor), and valueType = typeof(Guid)
gwt.when: TryConvertFromBytes(ref data, ref position, typeof(Guid), out result) is called
gwt.then: the data.Length >= 16 check passes against the full 16-byte span rather than the 15 bytes remaining from position 1, so the read is attempted; the Guid(ReadOnlySpan<byte>) constructor is called on data.Slice(1), which is only 15 bytes long, and throws ArgumentException because its input is not exactly 16 bytes -- TryConvertFromBytes does not return false and position is never advanced
